svg.title: The Spindle: mech frames for the six ape kinds
svg.text: Gear::Mech concept: every ape kind as an armoured frame. Hard plates over each body part, dark joints between them, a glowing visor or mono-eye, boosters on the back.
Kept clear of the map's own colours:

g.text: Two broad tan plates frame the
Unit 02 on the chest; the visor
Sits low under a brow visor;
The Gundam head: a gold V-fin,
a blue chest with yellow vents.
red feet and a red hip plate.
A gold fin over a red slit
Long forearm plates, a blade fin
Cyan, in a dark rail across
Three ring segments and a ram
plate in yellow over the chest.

svg.text: SCHEMES · the racer's colour choice picks one (main, secondary, accent, frame, glow)
